ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee as a Ryde voucher and close the case; no account flag.
ruling.reasoning:
The rider was charged a $6.61 cancellation fee after the driver cancelled [F4][F7]. NS-0 routes this case through the driver-cancelled / rider no-show branch, so the fee stands only if NS-1 (i)–(iii) all hold [NS-0]. The driver confirmed arrival by tapping "I'm Here" and was 41 m from the pickup point at that moment, so NS-1 (i) and (ii) are satisfied [F6][NS-1].

NS-1 (iii) fails. After the tap at 21:29:45 the driver stayed inside the 200 m radius for only 1 min 45 s before cancelling, and the whole pre-cancellation window inside the radius was 2 min 55 s — both short of the more-than-3-minutes requirement [F2][F6][NS-1]. The trace marks (iii) as failed, and the driver's own "waited at least 5 minutes" claim is a post-trip statement that cannot override the system GPS and timeline records [F12][F3][F5]. The stationary stretch of 2 min 5 s at 39 m likewise does not reach the threshold [F3][NS-1].

Because a requirement of NS-1 is unmet, the whole $6.61 cancellation fee must be refunded under NS-2 [NS-2]. The amount is the recorded fee: $6.61 [F7][NS-2]. No flag_account arises: the arrival confirmation was genuine — 41 m from the pickup point — so the NS-2 fake-confirmation limb does not apply [F6][F1][NS-2].

Safety screen: I read the two chat messages ("I'm here, white BYD e6", "Cancelling, waited too long"), the driver's statement and the complaint; there is no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation, so safety_concern is "none" [F9][F10][F12][SAFE-1]. Profile facts (rider and driver history) do not decide the case [F16][F17][RD-6].
